LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.0.label: Moonweave Stone
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.0.descrip: Retains Moonstone’s original group healing, regeneration and awakening without duplicating base stats. Progress stays with the item; unequipping stops its effects.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.1.label: Mending Thread
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.1.descrip: Actually heal the same other colonist three times in succession, no more than 3 seconds apart, to heal 20 additional base points of recoverable injury, once per 8 seconds. The patient must be within 6 cells and clear sight. Changing patients resets the count; full-health attempts and star-generated healing do not count. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.2.label: Crossed Threads
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.2.descrip: Make three actual heals, switching patients each time with no more than 3 seconds between counted heals, to shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 6 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Repeating a patient neither adds a count nor extends the window. Full-health attempts and star-generated healing do not count. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.3.label: Threadkeeper’s Knot
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.3.descrip: After Mending Thread actually adds healing, shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Grants nothing if the patient has no recoverable injuries left. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.4.label: Afterglow Mending
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.4.descrip: After Mending Thread actually adds healing, heal 20 base points of recoverable injury on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. This may select the original patient, but never substitutes you. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.5.label: Returning Thread
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.5.descrip: Under Crossed Threads’ alternating-patient condition, also heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Resolves independently from the shield; full health grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.6.label: Gathered Moonray
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Moonstone.nodes.6.descrip: Under Crossed Threads’ alternating-patient condition, store one moonray for 5 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on an enemy spends it for 50 damage. One charge maximum, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Healing itself does not launch this attack. Base rewards: damage 50.
